tools.name: bsale_list_documents
tools.description: List issued documents (boletas, facturas, notas de credito, guias...) newest-first as Bsale returns them, with number, dates, net/tax/total amounts, state, SII status and public PDF link. Filter by emission date range, document type, client, office, folio number or SII code. Use expand (details, pay

tools.name: bsale_get_document
tools.description: One document by id with its amounts, dates, state and links. Use expand=[details,payments,client,office,document_type,references,sellers] to include line items, payments and related records. GET /v1/documents/{id}.json.

tools.name: bsale_sales_summary
tools.description: Totals of sales documents (net, tax, total, count) by month, document type and office for a date range; set per_document to list each document instead. Good for 'how much did we sell in September?'. GET /v1/documents/summary.json.

tools.name: bsale_list_returns
tools.description: List returns (devoluciones) with date, motive, amounts and the credit note issued. Use expand=[reference_document,credit_note,details] for more. GET /v1/returns.json.

tools.name: bsale_list_document_types
tools.description: List document types (boleta, factura, nota de credito, guia de despacho...) with their id and tax (SII) code. Use the id when filtering documents. GET /v1/document_types.json.

tools.name: bsale_list_clients
tools.description: List customers with name, tax id (code), email, phone, address, credit limit and loyalty points. Filter by tax id, name, last name or email. GET /v1/clients.json.

tools.name: bsale_get_client
tools.description: One customer by id. Use expand=[contacts,attributes,addresses] to include contacts and extra attributes. GET /v1/clients/{id}.json.

tools.name: bsale_client_unpaid_documents
tools.description: A client's receivables: overdue and upcoming debt, total owed, and the unpaid documents with amounts. Give client_id or client_code. GET /v1/clients/unpaid_documents.json.

tools.name: bsale_list_products
tools.description: List products and services (name, description, class, stock control, state). SKUs live on variants: see bsale_list_variants. GET /v1/products.json.

tools.name: bsale_get_product
tools.description: One product by id; expand=[product_type] adds the type. GET /v1/products/{id}.json.

tools.name: bsale_list_variants
tools.description: List product variants, the sellable SKUs: description, SKU code, barcode, stock settings and product link. Search by SKU code, barcode, description or product id. GET /v1/variants.json.

tools.name: bsale_get_variant
tools.description: One variant (SKU) by id; expand=[product] embeds the product. GET /v1/variants/{id}.json.

tools.name: bsale_list_stocks
tools.description: Stock per variant and office: quantity, reserved and available. Filter by office, variant id, SKU code or barcode (for a pack give a variant filter plus office_id). expand=[variant,office] adds names. GET /v1/stocks.json.

tools.name: bsale_list_price_lists
tools.description: List price lists with name, currency and state. Use the id with bsale_list_price_list_details. GET /v1/price_lists.json.

tools.name: bsale_list_price_list_details
tools.description: Prices in one price list: the net price (variantValue) and price with taxes per variant, plus the detail id needed to change a price. Filter by variant id, SKU code or barcode. GET /v1/price_lists/{id}/details.json.

tools.name: bsale_list_payments
tools.description: List payments received (amount, date, payment type, document, office, user). Filter by payment date, document id, or document tax code plus folio number. GET /v1/payments.json.

tools.name: bsale_list_payment_types
tools.description: List payment methods (cash, card, transfer, credit...) with their id. The id is needed to record a payment. GET /v1/payment_types.json.

tools.name: bsale_list_offices
tools.description: List branches (sucursales) with name, address and cost center. Use the id for stock and document filters. GET /v1/offices.json.

tools.name: bsale_list_users
tools.description: List Bsale users (sellers/cashiers) with name and office. GET /v1/users.json.

tools.name: bsale_user_sales_summary
tools.description: Sales and tax subtotal per seller for a date range (default: today, UTC), or for one user. GET /v1/users/sales_summary.json.

tools.name: bsale_create_client
tools.description: WRITE: create a new customer in Bsale (it is visible to every user of the instance). Give at least a first name or a company. Bsale rejects a second client with the same tax id. POST /v1/clients.json.

tools.name: bsale_update_client
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing customer; only the fields you pass are sent. This overwrites the stored values. PUT /v1/clients/{id}.json.

tools.name: bsale_update_price
tools.description: WRITE: set the net price (variantValue, without taxes) of one variant in a price list. This changes what Bsale charges on new sales using that list. Get detail_id from bsale_list_price_list_details. PUT /v1/price_lists/{id}/details/{detail_id}.json.

tools.name: bsale_create_stock_reception
tools.description: WRITE: record a stock reception (ingreso de stock) that ADDS quantities to an office's inventory. Each line names the variant by id, SKU code or barcode, with quantity and unit cost. It changes stock levels and cost; Bsale has no undo through this API, so confirm the numbers first. POST /v1/stocks/r

tools.name: bsale_create_payment
tools.description: WRITE: record a payment against an issued document (normally a credit sale that is still unpaid). It changes the document's receivable balance in the books and cannot be removed through this API. Check the amount with bsale_client_unpaid_documents first and get payment_type_id from bsale_list_paymen

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "bsale_list_clients" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: code, first_name, last_name, email, state, expand, limit, offset

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bsale_list_clients, bsale_create_payment · Private data: bsale_list_documents, bsale_get_document, bsale_sales_summary, bsale_list_document_types, bsale_get_client, bsale_client_unpaid_documents, bsale_list_payments, bsale_list_payment_types, bsale_list_offices, bsale_create_stock_reception, bsale_create_payment · Public sink: bsale_list_clients, bsale_create_client, bsale_create_stock_reception, bsale_create_payment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bsale_list_clients, bsale_create_payment · Private data: bsale_list_documents, bsale_get_document, bsale_sales_summary, bsale_list_document_types, bsale_get_client, bsale_client_unpaid_documents, bsale_list_payments, bsale_list_payment_types, bsale_list_offices, bsale_create_stock_reception, bsale_create_payment · Public sink: bsale_list_clients, bsale_create_client, bsale_create_stock_reception, bsale_create_payment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
